results.reasoning: (A) attention - predict where we should pay attention → attention. (B) poorly - tend to perform ___ + later 'he also would perform poorly'. (C) subtle - most ___ changes in the jungle → subtle.
(A) profoundly - ___ illustrated → profoundly. (B) detect - They can ___ the most subtle changes → detect. (C) ease - build and tear down shelters with ___ → ease.
(A) expectations - Different environments create different ___ → expectations. (B) wandering - an adventure ___ through the jungle → wandering. (C) ability - has no ___ to pay attention → ability.
③ excellently는 원문 poorly의 반의어. 나머지(predict, expectations, detect)는 원문 일치.
② obvious는 원문 subtle의 반의어. 나머지(illustrated, trained, shelters)는 원문 일치.
① extremely는 원문 hardly의 반대. 'hardly stupid'이 'extremely stupid'으로 바뀌면 문맥 반대.
'we use ___ to predict where we should pay attention' → 뒤에 pay attention 반복 → attention.
'following the tracks of a ___' → 흔적을 따라가는 대상 → predator(포식자).
'have been ___ to do since childhood' → 현재완료 수동태 → trained.
detect(감지하다) ≈ notice(알아채다). ignore는 반의어.
profoundly(심오하게) ≈ deeply(깊이). briefly/casually/partially 모두 불일치.
predict(예측하다) ≈ anticipate(예상하다). remember/measure/prevent 무관.
poorly(서투르게) ↔ skillfully(능숙하게). slowly/simply/rarely는 반의어 아님.
subtle(미묘한) ↔ obvious(명백한). complex/careful/hidden은 반의어 아님.
(A) leave alone = 내버려두다, (B) leave the company = 떠나다. ① 순서 일치.
'animal that hunts and kills other animals for food' = predator(포식자).
profound(형용사) → profoundly(부사). 동사 illustrated 수식.
train → trained. have been + p.p.(현재완료 수동태).
'has no ability to ___ these things' → pay attention to. 원문 'pay attention to these things' 그대로.
'can ___ shelters with ease' → build and tear down. 원문 그대로.
